text:
Iris: FYI incoming pen-test next Wed. Need a short runbook covering RBAC, KMS, evidence uploads, log exports, and retest booking. Who can own?
Marcus: I can own RBAC + automation. Plan: create a time-limited role `pt/assessor/<id>` with MFA requirement and tag `pt-window=1799998001`.
Leah: KMS: don't reuse service keys. We'll provision `alias/pt-evidence-<env>` in each account. Grants only to the assessor role and to the evidence ingestion service account. Auto-revoke at window close.
Owen: for logs, export CloudTrail, API gateway and app request logs to a read-only S3 path `pen-tests/1799998001/{env}/`. We should also snapshot index counts in ES before hand.
Nina: retention: Compliance wants 60d raw, 180d alert-level. We'll mirror parsed alerts to the SIEM for 180d. Set lifecycle rules on the bucket.
Marcus: quick IAM snippet for the ephemeral role we'll hand to assessors:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1799998001"}]}
```
Leah: KMS grant example (ops):
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence-1799998001 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1799998001 --operations Encrypt Decrypt --constraints "{\"EncryptionContextSubset\":{\"purpose\":\"pen-test\"}}"
```
Iris: Good. Evidence upload: we want presigned PUTs with 4h expiry. Prefer unique prefixes per assessor to avoid collisions. Owen: can infra-bot provision presigned URLs?
infra-bot: presigned-svc deployed. Use /presign endpoint with params {bucket, key_prefix, expires=14400}. Auth: service token.
Marcus: verification: require assessor to publish SHA256 checksum next to upload and we verify after transfer. Add a small lambda that computes and records checksum in Dynamo.
Leah: also capture audit trail: record who assumed the role, grant id, and S3 object keys. Export CloudTrail events to the evidence bucket under `audit/`.
Nina: add a quick escalation ladder in runbook: product-security oncall -> platform lead -> legal contact. Include SLO for response (30m for access questions).
Iris: scheduling: dry-run Wed 06:30, live Wed 09:00, retest Thu 14:00-16:00. Can we reserve two 30m windows on Thu?
Owen: booked Thu 14:00-14:30 and 15:00-15:30 on the shared calendar and linked in RW-PT-2026 ticket.
Marcus: automation tasks: PR with terraform module for role + KMS + lifecycle; revoke job scheduled at 1799998001+6h. I'll push branch and ping.
Leah: I'll add grant/revoke playbooks and a dry-run checklist: 1) provision role, 2) create KMS key + grant, 3) generate presigned URL, 4) test assume-role -> upload -> checksum verify, 5) confirm CloudTrail export.
Iris: perfect. infra-bot: create ticket?
infra-bot: Jira created RW-PT-2026-1799998001: "pen-test evidence pipeline + RBAC/KMS runbook". Assignees: Marcus, Leah.
Nina: I'll draft the compliance checklist and put it into the ticket (retention rules, SIEM mirror, audit manifest).
Marcus: will notify assessors with ephemeral role ARNs and presigned links after dry-run passes.
Iris: action items TL;DR: Marcus (role + presign automation), Leah (KMS grants + revoke), Owen (export + bucket lifecycle), Nina (compliance checklist), infra-bot (ticket + presign svc). Dry-run Wed 06:30.
Leah: thumbs up. See you at dry-run. :white_check_mark:
